assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: WorldEngine Live World Style B art-direction reference sheet. Fresh landscape educational board, ivory margins, restrained readable typography. Reference images are STYLE ONLY: dimensional simplified meshes, broad real light and cool shadow, smooth colour families; no photographic textures or heavy outlines. Vehicles generic/unbranded: no logos, agency lettering, ads, route numbers or identifiable airline markings; agency-inspired colour accents allowed. No invented slogans. Title RAIL VEHICLES. Three rows labelled CHICAGO RAPID TRANSIT, COMMUTER RAIL, DENVER LIGHT RAIL. Three columns STREET · NEAR, STREET · DISTANT, AERIAL. Rapid transit: short silver single-level urban rail car, blue end caps, repeated paired doors, dark blue-grey opaque windows, simple flat roof boxes, shown in 2-car example. Commuter: silver double-deck gallery coaches with TWO window levels behind a substantial blue/red-accent diesel locomotive, no logo; make taller longer coaches visibly distinct from rapid-transit. Denver light rail: long articulated white/silver angular tram with muted red and dark blue band, black window strip, one visible pantograph and centre accordion articulation, shown one vehicle. Near cells front-three-quarter reveal silhouettes and doors, distant cells deliberately simplify tiny details, aerial cells actual steep top view show roofs, carriage spacing, turning segments. No transparent interiors, no realistic metal photo grain. Wheels and undercarriage simplified dark masses. Train sizes realistic relative to tracks. Ivory background on small plain track base islands; no branding.

Preserve the entire sheet's layout, all labels, all other panels, colours, lighting, world views, and scale progression unchanged. Do not add logos or lettering.
